Appearing in normal weapon configuration. *Before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], two [[Soldier]]s could be seen inside the '''Pursuit''' on the Level 4 upgrade icon, even though no person could be seen inside the '''Pursuit''' at the time. *The second Level 2 and Level 3 upgrade icons depict two people controlling the '''Pursuit''', but only one person is seen controlling the helicopter at these levels. *The in-game icon for the Default '''Pursuit''' shows the pilots of the helicopter not having any animations. *The {{Color|DuckyRevenge|Eggy}} skin was renamed to {{Color|DuckyRevenge|Easter}} after [[v1.71.0]]. ==Update History== ''This only refers to cosmetic changes to the [[Pursuit]].
